title: P2 manager.direct: request
description: Body of P2 manager.direct: a directive to the farm manager from a person with manager.direct. It applies only in the tenant of the call; in a tenant with farm_manager.enabled: false the denial manager_disabled (MGR-42). Only the closed fields (scope and operation) and a text typed by the person themselves, up to 1000 characters, reach the decision role; there are no quotes or attachments. The permissions of operations by a directive are the seat's permissions ∩ the person's permissions (MGR-4).

kind.description: Scope of the directive: a role, worker, catalog resource or incident number in the tenant.

id.description: Object id from the restricted character set [a-z0-9:_.-]{1,64}: catalog name, resource, task type, worker, task.

text.description: Text typed by the person themselves.
